items_all.title: Slack推出Slack Code，讓團隊與AI代理人共同開發程式
items_all.summary: Salesforce週四（8/20）推出Slack Code，讓企業團隊可在Slack中與AI程式代理人共同開發、檢視及修改程式碼。 Slack過去已能整合各種AI代理人，但相關功能主要用於對話及個別任務。隨著Claude Code、Devin、GitHub Copilot及ChatGPT等代理人開始處理更複雜的程式開發，開發者與AI的討論及修改過程通常只有自己看得到，其他團隊成員難以同步參與。

items_all.title: Mac版ChatGPT新增Apple Messages外掛、歐盟地區加入電腦使用紀錄
items_all.summary: macOS版ChatGPT及Codex本週加入數項功能，包括能為使用者傳送Apple訊息、Codex使用者可分享對話串給他人、歐盟地區使用者還能獲得電腦使用紀錄。 本週OpenAI為macOS版ChatGPT及代理式開發工具Codex加入的第一項功能是新增Apple Messages外掛。現在各方案的ChatGPT macOS版App都能安裝，不過只有Codex和ChatGPT Work才能啟用新功能。安裝完成後，ChatGPT就能讀取和搜尋iMessages、簡訊或RCS訊息，還能代使用者從Messages App傳送訊息。

items_all.summary: PDFs are easy to read and hard to change. AI can now summarize a 90-page contract in seconds, but it still won't rewrite the source file cleanly. UPDF is built for that second half: direct editing, 14-format conversion, 38-language OCR, and ten AI agents shipped in version 2.5. The post Meet UPDF: A Lightweight Adobe Alternative Built for the Agentic Era appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: PDF 易於閱讀但難以更改。人工智慧現在可以在幾秒鐘內總結一份 90 頁的合同，但它仍然無法乾淨地重寫原始檔。 UPDF 是為後半部分而構建的：直接編輯、14 種格式轉換、38 種語言 OCR 以及 2.5 版本中提供的 10 個 AI 代理。帖子“認識 UPDF：為代理時代構建的輕量級 Adob​​e 替代方案”首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items_all.title: LLMs could write like humans but post-training guardrails make their text detectable
items_all.summary: LLMs don't write in a recognizable style because they can't do better. Post-training and safety guardrails sharply narrow their expressive range, argues Pangram CTO Bradley Emi. Base models without these constraints already write with far more variety. The article LLMs could write like humans but post-training guardrails make their text detectable appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: LLMs 不以可識別的風格編寫，因為他們無法做得更好。 Pangram 技術長 Bradley Emi 認為，訓練後和安全護欄大大縮小了它們的表達範圍。沒有這些限制的基本模型已經可以編寫出更多樣的內容。文章 LLMs 可以像人類一樣寫作，但訓練後護欄使他們的文字可檢測到，首先出現在解碼器上。

items_all.title: KI-Pioneer Sutton calls synthetic data a "big mistake" in the face of an infinitely complex world
items_all.summary: Turing Award winner Richard Sutton calls synthetic data a "big mistake" for scaling large language models. The world is infinitely complex, and any simulation of it is "microscopic," with human expertise acting as a bottleneck that blocks real scaling. Sutton's alternative is agents that learn continually from their own experience instead of relying on frozen models. The article KI-Pioneer Sutton calls synthetic data a "big mistake" in the face of an infinitely complex world appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 圖靈獎得主理查德·薩頓 (Richard Sutton) 稱合成資料對於擴充套件大型語言模型來說是一個“大錯誤”。世界無限複雜，任何模擬都是“微觀的”，人類的專業知識成為阻礙真正擴充套件的瓶頸。薩頓的替代方案是讓智慧體不斷從自己的經驗中學習，而不是依賴凍結的模型。 KI-Pioneer Sutton 的文章稱面對無限複雜的世界，合成資料是一個“大錯誤”，該文章首先發表在 The Decoder 上。

items_all.title: China now has its own AI circular financing scheme
items_all.summary: Unitree Robotics rose 460 percent in its Shanghai IPO, hitting a valuation of around $50 billion. But an FT report shows much of the demand for its robots comes from state-backed training centers that buy the machines and sell the resulting data back to the manufacturers, a circular business model that echoes the Nvidia criticism in the US. The article China now has its own AI circular financing scheme appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Unitree Robotics 在上海 IPO 中股價上漲 460%，估值達到約 500 億美元。但英國《金融時報》的一份報告顯示，對其機器人的大部分需求來自國家支援的培訓中心，這些中心購買機器並將生成的資料賣回給製造商，這種循環商業模式與輝達在美國的批評相呼應。文章《中國現在有了自己的人工智慧循環融資方案》首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all.summary: The United Arab Emirates (UAE) has been early in adopting artificial intelligence for 9 years. It published a national AI strategy in October 2017 and, days later, created a ministerial post to run it, making Omar Sultan Al Olama the world’s first minister of state for artificial intelligence at 27. In the years since, it […] The post Agentic AI in government just hit the hard part: deciding what a machine may decide appeared first on AI News .
items_all.summary_zh: 阿拉伯聯合大公國 (UAE) 早在 9 年前就採用了人工智慧。它於 2017 年 10 月釋出了國家人工智慧戰略，幾天後，設立了一個部長級職位來管理該戰略，使 27 歲的奧馬爾·蘇丹·阿爾·奧拉馬 (Omar Sultan Al Olama) 成為世界上第一位負責人工智慧的國務部長。此後的幾年裡，政府中的代理人工智慧職位剛剛觸及最困難的部分：決定機器可以決定什麼，首先出現在《人工智慧新聞》上。

items_all.title: Auditing Preference Biases and Fine-Tuning Language Models with Direct Preference Optimization on Anthropic HH-RLHF Using TRL and LoRA
items_all.summary: This tutorial provides an end-to-end workflow for fine-tuning language models using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). We demonstrate how to audit the Anthropic HH-RLHF dataset for structural and length-based biases, implement a robust training pipeline using TRL and LoRA, and evaluate model performance to ensure genuine preference learning rather than reliance on lexical shortcuts. The post Auditing Preference Biases and Fine-Tuning Language Models with Direct Preference Optimization on Anthropic HH-RLHF Using TRL and LoRA appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: 本教程提供了使用直接偏好最佳化 (DPO) 微調語言模型的端到端工作流程。我們演示瞭如何稽核 Anthropic HH-RLHF 資料集的結構和基於長度的偏差，使用 TRL 和 LoRA 實施強大的訓練管道，並評估模型效能以確保真正的偏好學習而不是依賴詞彙快捷方式。使用 TRL 和 LoRA 在 Anthropic HH-RLHF 上使用直接偏好最佳化來審計偏好偏差和微調語言模型的帖子首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items_all.title: Terence Tao says AI could trigger math's biggest crisis since Gödel
items_all.summary: In a new essay, Terence Tao warns that AI could push mathematics into a crisis on par with the foundational upheaval around 1900. What's being tested this time isn't mathematical truth but the values of the field: what counts as a contribution, what gets rewarded, and who did the work. His rule of thumb: a proof that no human can explain should be considered incomplete. The article Terence Tao says AI could trigger math's biggest crisis since Gödel appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 陶哲軒在一篇新文章中警告說，人工智慧可能會將數學推入一場與 1900 年左右的基礎性劇變不相上下的危機。這次考驗的不是數學真理，而是該領域的價值：什麼算作貢獻、什麼得到獎勵以及誰做了這項工作。他的經驗法則是：無人能解釋的證明應該被認為是不完整的。陶哲軒的文章稱人工智慧可能引發自哥德爾首次出現在解碼器以來數學上最大的危機。

items_all.title: ChatGPT search now uses the site:operator at scale
items_all.summary: ChatGPT search now uses the site:operator at scale Promptwatch is part of the emerging "GEO" space, for Generative Engine Optimization - the chatbot version of SEO, where companies offer tools and consulting to help your site increase its presence in replies to prompts inside tools like ChatGPT. The Promptwatch product uses automation to track responses to prompts across end-user chat products like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. They publish aggregate reports on this as part of their own content marketing strategy, which do seem to provide credible hints as to otherwise invisible design changes to those products. Their own tracking shows a notable change aligned with the GPT-5.6 rollout earlier this month: The percentage of all ChatGPT Search fanout queries that contain the site:operator, per day. The share hovered between 0.3% and 0.5% for weeks, dipped briefly to 0.15% on August 3 to 5 (consistent with a staged rollout or pre-launch experiment), then jumped to 16-17% on August 8. It's important to note that these figures only reflect the prompts for which they have automated tracking enabled. This corresponds to OpenAI's somewhat vague August 6th announcement : For Plus and Pro users, we’re updating GPT‑5.6 Sol in Chat to be more reliable with facts and provide more focused answers. Once again I am hampered by OpenAI's decision to actively obscure their system prompts, but from poking at ChatGPT I believe their latest search tool has a shape like search(query, recency, domains) rather than encouraging a site: operator directly. In a follow-up on August 18th Promptwatch repo
items_all.summary_zh: ChatGPT 搜尋現在使用 site:operator 大規模 Promptwatch 是新興“GEO”空間的一部分，用於生成引擎最佳化（SEO 的聊天機器人版本），公司提供工具和諮詢來幫助您的網站在回覆 ChatGPT 等工具內的提示時提高其存在感。 Promptwatch 產品使用自動化技術來跟蹤 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Gemini 等終端使用者聊天產品的提示響應。他們釋出了有關此問題的彙總報告，作為自己的內容營銷策略的一部分，這似乎確實為這些產品的其他隱形設計更改提供了可靠的提示。他們自己的跟蹤顯示了與本月早些時候推出的 GPT-5.6 一致的顯著變化：每天包含 site:operator 的所有 ChatGPT 搜尋扇出查詢的百分比。該份額連續數週徘徊在 0.3% 至 0.5% 之間，8 月 3 日至 5 日短暫下跌至 0.15%（與分階段推出或釋出前實驗一致），然後在 8 月 8 日躍升至 16-17%。值得注意的是，這些數字僅反映了啟用自動跟蹤的提示。這與 OpenAI's 8 月 6 日的公告相對應，有些模糊：對於 Plus 和 Pro 使用者，我們正在更新 Chat 中的 GPT‑5.6 Sol，以便更可靠地提供事實並提供更有針對性的答案。我再次受到 OpenAI's 決定主動模糊其系統提示的阻礙，但透過戳 ChatGPT，我相信他們最新的搜尋工具具有類似搜尋（查詢、新近度、域）的形狀，而不是直接鼓勵 site: 操作員。在 8 月 18 日 Promptwatch 回購協議的後續行動中

items_all.title: A shot-scraper-style JSON API on Bun 1.4's new Bun.WebView
items_all.summary: Research: A shot-scraper-style JSON API on Bun 1.4's new Bun.WebView Today saw the long awaited release of Bun 1.4 , the first stable version since the infamous Rust rewrite a few months ago . Interestingly, the Rust rewrite was downplayed in the release notes, which introduced a bewildering array of new features and claimed 2,900 additional bug fixes: Bun 1.4 adds +1,517 tests from the Node.js test suite - our biggest jump in Node.js compatibility since Bun 1.0. Bun v1.4 also fixes over 2,900 issues. It reduces idle CPU usage by 5x, reduces memory usage by up to 35%, and starts 50% faster on Linux. It adds Bun.Image , Bun.WebView , Bun.markdown , Bun.cron() , Bun.Terminal , bun run --parallel , bun test --parallel , bun audit fix , bun dedupe , and bun prune . And it rewrites Bun from Zig to Rust. Of these the one that most caught my eye was Bun.WebView , which adds first class support for browser automation to Bun core using either macOS WebKit or control of a local Chromium process via the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP). I had Claude Code for web build a prototype of a web API providing the ability to load a web page and then execute JavaScript against it, inspired by my shot-scraper javascript CLI tool - partly to see how much RAM would be needed by such a service. Here's that TypeScript server implementation , which appears to need a 192MB-256MB container to run a full Chrome against complex web pages - tested using cgroups. Tags: browsers , javascript , ai , rust , typescript , generative-ai , llms , coding-agents , bun

items_all.title: GPT-5.6 Sol Pro tops Editorial Craft benchmark with 0.97 score
items_all.summary: In a 12-task Editorial Craft evaluation of 12 AI models, OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol Pro ranked first with a 0.97 score at $0.0091 per task. OpenAI claimed four of the top six spots, while Grok 4.6 and Claude Opus 4.8 tied at 0.93 among the leading non-OpenAI models.
items_all.summary_zh: 在對 12 個 AI 模型進行的 12 任務Editorial Craft 評估中，OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol Pro 以每項任務 0.0091 美元的 0.97 分排名第一。 OpenAI 佔據前六名中的四席，而 Grok 4.6 和 Claude Opus 4.8 在領先的非 OpenAI 模型中並列，得分為 0.93。

items_all_raw.title: Slack推出Slack Code，讓團隊與AI代理人共同開發程式
items_all_raw.summary: Salesforce週四（8/20）推出Slack Code，讓企業團隊可在Slack中與AI程式代理人共同開發、檢視及修改程式碼。 Slack過去已能整合各種AI代理人，但相關功能主要用於對話及個別任務。隨著Claude Code、Devin、GitHub Copilot及ChatGPT等代理人開始處理更複雜的程式開發，開發者與AI的討論及修改過程通常只有自己看得到，其他團隊成員難以同步參與。

items_all_raw.title: Mac版ChatGPT新增Apple Messages外掛、歐盟地區加入電腦使用紀錄
items_all_raw.summary: macOS版ChatGPT及Codex本週加入數項功能，包括能為使用者傳送Apple訊息、Codex使用者可分享對話串給他人、歐盟地區使用者還能獲得電腦使用紀錄。 本週OpenAI為macOS版ChatGPT及代理式開發工具Codex加入的第一項功能是新增Apple Messages外掛。現在各方案的ChatGPT macOS版App都能安裝，不過只有Codex和ChatGPT Work才能啟用新功能。安裝完成後，ChatGPT就能讀取和搜尋iMessages、簡訊或RCS訊息，還能代使用者從Messages App傳送訊息。

items_all_raw.title: ChatGPT search now uses the site:operator at scale
items_all_raw.summary: ChatGPT search now uses the site:operator at scale Promptwatch is part of the emerging "GEO" space, for Generative Engine Optimization - the chatbot version of SEO, where companies offer tools and consulting to help your site increase its presence in replies to prompts inside tools like ChatGPT. The Promptwatch product uses automation to track responses to prompts across end-user chat products like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. They publish aggregate reports on this as part of their own content marketing strategy, which do seem to provide credible hints as to otherwise invisible design changes to those products. Their own tracking shows a notable change aligned with the GPT-5.6 rollout earlier this month: The percentage of all ChatGPT Search fanout queries that contain the site:operator, per day. The share hovered between 0.3% and 0.5% for weeks, dipped briefly to 0.15% on August 3 to 5 (consistent with a staged rollout or pre-launch experiment), then jumped to 16-17% on August 8. It's important to note that these figures only reflect the prompts for which they have automated tracking enabled. This corresponds to OpenAI's somewhat vague August 6th announcement : For Plus and Pro users, we’re updating GPT‑5.6 Sol in Chat to be more reliable with facts and provide more focused answers. Once again I am hampered by OpenAI's decision to actively obscure their system prompts, but from poking at ChatGPT I believe their latest search tool has a shape like search(query, recency, domains) rather than encouraging a site: operator directly. In a follow-up on August 18th Promptwatch repo
items_all_raw.summary_zh: ChatGPT 搜尋現在使用 site:operator 大規模 Promptwatch 是新興“GEO”空間的一部分，用於生成引擎最佳化（SEO 的聊天機器人版本），公司提供工具和諮詢來幫助您的網站在回覆 ChatGPT 等工具內的提示時提高其存在感。 Promptwatch 產品使用自動化技術來跟蹤 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Gemini 等終端使用者聊天產品的提示響應。他們釋出了有關此問題的彙總報告，作為自己的內容營銷策略的一部分，這似乎確實為這些產品的其他隱形設計更改提供了可靠的提示。他們自己的跟蹤顯示了與本月早些時候推出的 GPT-5.6 一致的顯著變化：每天包含 site:operator 的所有 ChatGPT 搜尋扇出查詢的百分比。該份額連續數週徘徊在 0.3% 至 0.5% 之間，8 月 3 日至 5 日短暫下跌至 0.15%（與分階段推出或釋出前實驗一致），然後在 8 月 8 日躍升至 16-17%。值得注意的是，這些數字僅反映了啟用自動跟蹤的提示。這與 OpenAI's 8 月 6 日的公告相對應，有些模糊：對於 Plus 和 Pro 使用者，我們正在更新 Chat 中的 GPT‑5.6 Sol，以便更可靠地提供事實並提供更有針對性的答案。我再次受到 OpenAI's 決定主動模糊其系統提示的阻礙，但透過戳 ChatGPT，我相信他們最新的搜尋工具具有類似搜尋（查詢、新近度、域）的形狀，而不是直接鼓勵 site: 操作員。在 8 月 18 日 Promptwatch 回購協議的後續行動中

items_all_raw.title: LLMs could write like humans but post-training guardrails make their text detectable
items_all_raw.summary: LLMs don't write in a recognizable style because they can't do better. Post-training and safety guardrails sharply narrow their expressive range, argues Pangram CTO Bradley Emi. Base models without these constraints already write with far more variety. The article LLMs could write like humans but post-training guardrails make their text detectable appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: LLMs 不以可識別的風格編寫，因為他們無法做得更好。 Pangram 技術長 Bradley Emi 認為，訓練後和安全護欄大大縮小了它們的表達範圍。沒有這些限制的基本模型已經可以編寫出更多樣的內容。文章 LLMs 可以像人類一樣寫作，但訓練後護欄使他們的文字可檢測到，首先出現在解碼器上。

items_all_raw.title: A shot-scraper-style JSON API on Bun 1.4's new Bun.WebView
items_all_raw.summary: Research: A shot-scraper-style JSON API on Bun 1.4's new Bun.WebView Today saw the long awaited release of Bun 1.4 , the first stable version since the infamous Rust rewrite a few months ago . Interestingly, the Rust rewrite was downplayed in the release notes, which introduced a bewildering array of new features and claimed 2,900 additional bug fixes: Bun 1.4 adds +1,517 tests from the Node.js test suite - our biggest jump in Node.js compatibility since Bun 1.0. Bun v1.4 also fixes over 2,900 issues. It reduces idle CPU usage by 5x, reduces memory usage by up to 35%, and starts 50% faster on Linux. It adds Bun.Image , Bun.WebView , Bun.markdown , Bun.cron() , Bun.Terminal , bun run --parallel , bun test --parallel , bun audit fix , bun dedupe , and bun prune . And it rewrites Bun from Zig to Rust. Of these the one that most caught my eye was Bun.WebView , which adds first class support for browser automation to Bun core using either macOS WebKit or control of a local Chromium process via the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP). I had Claude Code for web build a prototype of a web API providing the ability to load a web page and then execute JavaScript against it, inspired by my shot-scraper javascript CLI tool - partly to see how much RAM would be needed by such a service. Here's that TypeScript server implementation , which appears to need a 192MB-256MB container to run a full Chrome against complex web pages - tested using cgroups. Tags: browsers , javascript , ai , rust , typescript , generative-ai , llms , coding-agents , bun

items_all_raw.title: KI-Pioneer Sutton calls synthetic data a "big mistake" in the face of an infinitely complex world
items_all_raw.summary: Turing Award winner Richard Sutton calls synthetic data a "big mistake" for scaling large language models. The world is infinitely complex, and any simulation of it is "microscopic," with human expertise acting as a bottleneck that blocks real scaling. Sutton's alternative is agents that learn continually from their own experience instead of relying on frozen models. The article KI-Pioneer Sutton calls synthetic data a "big mistake" in the face of an infinitely complex world appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 圖靈獎得主理查德·薩頓 (Richard Sutton) 稱合成資料對於擴充套件大型語言模型來說是一個“大錯誤”。世界無限複雜，任何模擬都是“微觀的”，人類的專業知識成為阻礙真正擴充套件的瓶頸。薩頓的替代方案是讓智慧體不斷從自己的經驗中學習，而不是依賴凍結的模型。 KI-Pioneer Sutton 的文章稱面對無限複雜的世界，合成資料是一個“大錯誤”，該文章首先發表在 The Decoder 上。

items_all_raw.title: China now has its own AI circular financing scheme
items_all_raw.summary: Unitree Robotics rose 460 percent in its Shanghai IPO, hitting a valuation of around $50 billion. But an FT report shows much of the demand for its robots comes from state-backed training centers that buy the machines and sell the resulting data back to the manufacturers, a circular business model that echoes the Nvidia criticism in the US. The article China now has its own AI circular financing scheme appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Unitree Robotics 在上海 IPO 中股價上漲 460%，估值達到約 500 億美元。但英國《金融時報》的一份報告顯示，對其機器人的大部分需求來自國家支援的培訓中心，這些中心購買機器並將生成的資料賣回給製造商，這種循環商業模式與輝達在美國的批評相呼應。文章《中國現在有了自己的人工智慧循環融資方案》首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all_raw.title: Agentic AI in government just hit the hard part: deciding what a machine may decide
items_all_raw.summary: The United Arab Emirates (UAE) has been early in adopting artificial intelligence for 9 years. It published a national AI strategy in October 2017 and, days later, created a ministerial post to run it, making Omar Sultan Al Olama the world’s first minister of state for artificial intelligence at 27. In the years since, it […] The post Agentic AI in government just hit the hard part: deciding what a machine may decide appeared first on AI News .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 阿拉伯聯合大公國 (UAE) 早在 9 年前就採用了人工智慧。它於 2017 年 10 月釋出了國家人工智慧戰略，幾天後，設立了一個部長級職位來管理該戰略，使 27 歲的奧馬爾·蘇丹·阿爾·奧拉馬 (Omar Sultan Al Olama) 成為世界上第一位負責人工智慧的國務部長。此後的幾年裡，政府中的代理人工智慧職位剛剛觸及最困難的部分：決定機器可以決定什麼，首先出現在《人工智慧新聞》上。

items_all_raw.title: Auditing Preference Biases and Fine-Tuning Language Models with Direct Preference Optimization on Anthropic HH-RLHF Using TRL and LoRA
items_all_raw.summary: This tutorial provides an end-to-end workflow for fine-tuning language models using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). We demonstrate how to audit the Anthropic HH-RLHF dataset for structural and length-based biases, implement a robust training pipeline using TRL and LoRA, and evaluate model performance to ensure genuine preference learning rather than reliance on lexical shortcuts. The post Auditing Preference Biases and Fine-Tuning Language Models with Direct Preference Optimization on Anthropic HH-RLHF Using TRL and LoRA appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 本教程提供了使用直接偏好最佳化 (DPO) 微調語言模型的端到端工作流程。我們演示瞭如何稽核 Anthropic HH-RLHF 資料集的結構和基於長度的偏差，使用 TRL 和 LoRA 實施強大的訓練管道，並評估模型效能以確保真正的偏好學習而不是依賴詞彙快捷方式。使用 TRL 和 LoRA 在 Anthropic HH-RLHF 上使用直接偏好最佳化來審計偏好偏差和微調語言模型的帖子首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items_all_raw.title: Terence Tao says AI could trigger math's biggest crisis since Gödel
items_all_raw.summary: In a new essay, Terence Tao warns that AI could push mathematics into a crisis on par with the foundational upheaval around 1900. What's being tested this time isn't mathematical truth but the values of the field: what counts as a contribution, what gets rewarded, and who did the work. His rule of thumb: a proof that no human can explain should be considered incomplete. The article Terence Tao says AI could trigger math's biggest crisis since Gödel appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 陶哲軒在一篇新文章中警告說，人工智慧可能會將數學推入一場與 1900 年左右的基礎性劇變不相上下的危機。這次考驗的不是數學真理，而是該領域的價值：什麼算作貢獻、什麼得到獎勵以及誰做了這項工作。他的經驗法則是：無人能解釋的證明應該被認為是不完整的。陶哲軒的文章稱人工智慧可能引發自哥德爾首次出現在解碼器以來數學上最大的危機。

items_all_raw.summary: Advertising inside ChatGPT arrived with a promise that the assistant already knows what the user wants. So far, that hasn’t entirely been the case. Searchable, the AI visibility platform, analysed more than 11,000 ads served inside real ChatGPT conversations between 4 July and 4 August 2026, pairing every ad with the conversation it appeared in, […] The post A third of ChatGPT ads appear in irrelevant conversations appeared first on AI News .
